menu.description:

Contains: Tree Nuts (coconut), Soy

menu.name: Marionberry Coconut Sherbet (v)
menu.description: While we’re lucky enough in Oregon to have these hulking berries hit our markets in summer, most of the world has never heard of them. Coconut cream and a little sugar are the only things we need to let the sweet-tart complexity of the marionberries shine in this creamy, refreshing flavor.Contains: Tree Nuts (coconut)

menu.name: Jasmine Milk Tea & Chocolate Almond Stracciatella
menu.description:
In this ice cream, exquisite jasmine tea is steeped in cream and sugar for exactly 12 minutes. Not one minute more or less. San Francisco’s Red Blossom Tea Company sources directly from rural areas of China and Taiwan during the spring tea harvest to make approachable but keenly flavored craft teas. Their Spring Jasmine Maofeng consists of handpicked early harvest green tea leaves from Fujian that get covered in a blanket of fresh jasmine blossoms, making for a tea with both body and deep jasmine aroma. The ice cream is flavored entirely with this tea, then drizzled with almond stracciatella.
Made with Red Blossom Tea
Contains: Milk, Tree Nuts (almonds)

menu.name: Rhubarb Crumble w/ Toasted Anise
menu.description:
Along the West Coast, the humble, hardy rhubarb is a welcome sign of spring. We transform the PNW’s abundance of rhubarb into a simple crumble a la mode. To do so, we dark roast anise for the crumble, delivering a floral punch that can stand up to the acidity of rhubarb jam, the sum more satisfyingly complex than its individual parts. 
Contains: Milk, Wheat

menu.name: Mathilde's Hibiscus & Coconut Sherbet (v)
menu.description:
Hailing from the remote high mountains of Haiti, Mathilde spent her childhood learning her family’s traditional recipes over open flame. As an adult, she returned to start her own non-profit in her village to fund projects for a school and a health clinic. Now, after a successful run at food incubator Portland Mercado, Mathilde is on a mission to showcase the richness and beauty of Haiti through a different lens. She’s turned Haiti’s national flower, the hibiscus, into a spicy ginger brew. We simply add coconut cream and churn it into a bright, tropical sherbet.
Made with Mathilde’s Kitchen
Contains: Tree Nuts (coconut)

menu.name: Cold Brew Coffee
menu.description: Featuring Caffe Vita's Signature Blends, Local Coffee Spot is proud to serve our Cold Brew Coffee. Our Cold Brew is slow-steeped in cool water, without touching heat; made from our custom blend of beans grown to steep long and cold for a super-smooth and rich flavor.

menu.name: Cold Brew Coffee with Milk
menu.description: Featuring Caffe Vita's Signature Blends, Local Coffee Spot is proud to serve our Cold Brew Coffee with Milk. Our Cold Brew is slow-steeped in cool water, without touching heat and finished with a splash of milk; made from our custom blend of beans grown to steep long and cold for a super-smooth flavor.

menu.name: Vanilla Sweet Cream Cold Brew
menu.description: Featuring Caffe Vita’s Signature Blends, Local Coffee Spot is proud to serve our Vanilla Sweet Cream Cold Brew; Cold Brew coffee accented with vanilla. And topped with a delicate float of vanilla sweet cream that cascades throughout the cup. Enjoy the waves of rich flavor in every sip!

menu.name: Cold Brew with Cinnamon Almond Milk Foam
menu.description: Featuring Caffe Vita's Signature Blends, Local Coffee Spot is proud to serve our Cold Brew with Cinnamon Almond Milk Foam; Cold Brew topped with lightly sweet cinnamon, vanilla syrup and almond milk cold foam. Enjoy the powerfully rich flavor in every sip!

menu.name: Cold Brew with Dark Cocoa Almond Milk Foam
menu.description: Featuring Caffe Vita's Signature Blends, Local Coffee Spot is proud to serve our Cold Brew with Dark Cocoa Almond Milk Foam; Cold Brew topped with lightly sweet mocha sauce, cocoa powder and almond milk cold foam. Enjoy the powerfully rich flavor in every sip!

menu.name: Cold Brew with Cinnamon Oat Milk Foam
menu.description: Featuring Caffe Vita's Signature Blends, Local Coffee Spot is proud to serve Cold Brew with Cinnamon Oat Milk Foam; Cold Brew topped with lightly sweet cinnamon, vanilla syrup and oat milk cold foam. Enjoy the powerfully rich flavor in every sip!

menu.name: Cold Brew with Salted Caramel Cream
menu.description: Featuring Caffe Vita's Signature Blends, Local Coffee Spot is proud to serve our Cold Brew with Salted Caramel Cream! Here's a savory-meets-sweet refreshing beverage certain to delight! Our signature, super-smooth cold brew, sweetened with a touch of caramel and topped with a salted, rich cold foam.

menu.name: Tiger-Mocha
menu.description: Local Coffee Spot is proud to serve the delicious Tiger-Mocha; Our rich, full-bodied espresso combined with bittersweet mocha sauce and steamed milk, then topped with sweetened whipped cream. The classic coffee drink that always sweetly satisfies.

menu.name: Salted Caramel Mocha
menu.description: Local Coffee Spot is proud to serve our Salted Caramel Mocha. Mocha sauce and toffee nut syrup are combined with coffee and steamed milk. We then top it with sweetened whipped cream, caramel drizzle and a blend of turbinado sugar and sea salt. Enjoy the flavors of fall in every sip!

menu.name: Milky Way Mocha
menu.description: Local Coffee Spot is proud to serve our chocolate lover's Milky Way Mocha; Made with our signature Caffe Vita espresso blend, steamed milk, and chocolatey swirls! This amazing and delicious Mocha Recipe is perfect for any day and any weather, you will want to curl up with this delicious beverage that will warm you up. Top it off with whipped cream and chocolate drizzle for the ultimate experience!

menu.name: Almond Joy Mocha
menu.description: Local Coffee Spot is proud to serve our Almond Joy Mocha; Made with our signature Caffe Vita espresso blend, steamed milk, with all the almond, coconut and chocolate flavor you love from an Almond Joy! This amazing and delicious Mocha Recipe is perfect for any day and any weather, you will want to curl up with this delicious beverage that will warm you up. Top it off with whipped cream and chocolate drizzle for the ultimate experience!

menu.name: Dark Chocolate Mocha
menu.description: Chocolate, Chocolate, and more Chocolate!  Local Coffee Spot is proud to serve our Dark Chocolate Mocha; Our small-lot espresso combined with cocoa, ground chocolate and topped with steamed milk delivers a brilliant combination of sweetness.

menu.name: White Chocolate Mocha
menu.description: Local Coffee Spot is proud to serve White Chocolate Mocha! Our signature espresso meets white chocolate sauce and steamed milk. Then it is finished off with sweetened whipped cream to create this classic white chocolate delight.

menu.name: Mocha
menu.description: Local Coffee Spot is proud to serve our Mocha. Our rich, full-bodied espresso combined with bittersweet mocha sauce and steamed milk, then topped with sweetened whipped cream. The classic coffee drink that always sweetly satisfies.

menu.name: Caramel Macchiato

menu.description: Local Coffee Spot is proud to offer our Chicken Caesar Wrap. Part salad, part sandwich, and completely delicious! This classic handheld wrap is filled full of flavor with sliced tender chicken, parmesan cheese, chopped Caesar croutons and the perfect amount of dressing to craft a bundle of happiness. Wrap your mind around that!

menu.name: Chicken Bacon Ranch Wrap
menu.description: Local Coffee Spot is proud to offer our Chicken Bacon Ranch Wrap. Part salad, part wrap, and completely delicious! This toasted handheld, soft tortilla wrap is filled full of flavor with roast deli-style chicken, bacon, lettuce and diced tomatoes! Wrap your mind around that!

menu.name: Veggie Wrap
menu.description: Local Coffee Spot is proud to offer our Veggie Wrap. This toasted handheld, soft tortilla wrap is filled full of fresh, succulent vegetables! It's extremely difficult to wrap your mind around such a healthy choice that tastes so good!

menu.name: Salad
menu.description: Local Coffee Spot is proud to offer our nutritious and delicious choices of Salad! Caesar, House, Chef, Club... you got it! After enjoying our leafy green layers of joy, the phrase "I'll just have a salad" will take on new meaning! If it pleases you, pair your salad with our hot and ready soup and enjoy the magic!

menu.name: Turkey Bacon Ranch Sandwich
menu.description: Who doesn't love a great sandwich? Local Coffee Spot is proud to offer the Turkey Bacon Ranch Sandwich! It comes with roast deli-style turkey, peppercorn ranch sauce and thick-cut pepper bacon. It also has cheddar cheese and is gently placed between two slices of your favorite bread (or lettuce) and drizzled with house made ranch! YUMMMM. Enjoy a choice side of Chips, Potato Salad or Slaw; served with house veggies.

menu.name: Ham & Cheddar Sandwich
menu.description: Local Coffee Spot is proud to offer our Ham & Cheddar Sandwich. Enjoy pure awesome thin sliced ham placed between two slices of your choice of bread, bagel, pita, but don't stop there. Build your perfect sandwich by simply requesting additions, along with your choice of sides. Enjoy a choice side of Chips, Potato Salad or Slaw; served with house veggies.

menu.name: Classic BLT Sandwich
menu.description: Local Coffee Spot is proud to offer the one and only Classic BLT! A BLT is a type of sandwich, named for the initials of its primary ingredients, bacon, lettuce, and tomato. Although, it has been known to translate to: Bacon, Little more bacon, Top it off with bacon. Enjoy a choice side of Chips, Potato Salad or Slaw; served with house veggies.

menu.name: Chicken Salad Sandwich
menu.description: Local Coffee Spot is proud to offer our Chicken Salad Sandwich. Who doesn't love a good Chicken Salad Sandwich? We love this salad between two slices of toasted sourdough bread, but it's also just as good straight up. Enjoy a choice side of Chips, Potato Salad or Slaw; served with house veggies.

menu.name: Turkey Sandwich
menu.description: Local Coffee Spot is proud to offer this one of a kind Turkey Sandwich. Enjoy this savory slow roasted thin sliced turkey meat gently placed between two pre-sliced slices of choice bread. Enjoy a choice side of Chips, Potato Salad or Slaw; served with house veggies.

menu.name: Panini -Bacon, Avocado, Sriracha
menu.description: Local Coffee Spot is proud to offer this specialty Bacon and Avocado Panini with Sriracha Aioli. The freshest bacon, lettuce and avocado packed between two slices of heavenly Italian bread and layered with shaved parmesan cheese. To top it off, enjoy the succulent Siracha Aioli spread! It tastes so magical, you might think this Panini is straight from Houdini!

menu.name: Panini -Grilled Cheese

restaurants.name: Salt & Straw (Capitol Hill)
restaurants.category: Ice Cream & Frozen Yogurt, Desserts, Comfort Food

menu.name: The Perfect Ice Cream Scoop
menu.description: The most trusted ice cream scoop in the world. The handle has heat-conductive fluid, which helps you create gorgeous, ‘gram-worthy scoops from every pint.
menu.recipe_name: apple pie in a scoop ice cream

menu.name: A Whiff of Waffle Cone Scented Candle
menu.description: A Whiff of Waffle Cone scented candle, created in partnership with Imaginary Authors, evokes memories of the sweet joy of crunching into a freshly baked waffle cone, with notes of Vanilla, Heavy Cream, and Salted Caramel. Accords of Amyris, Orgeat, and Saigon Cinnamon add a complexity to this decadent fragrance that will take you back to your favorite ice cream cone and all the happy memories that go along with it. Make coming home feel like coming to Salt & Straw. Sweet!

menu.name: A Whiff of Waffle Cone Perfume 14 ml
menu.description: A provocative and transportive unisex perfume created with our friends at Imaginary Authors. Notes of Vanilla, Heavy Cream, and Salted Caramel, with accords of Amyris, Orgeat, and Saigon Cinnamon will have you believing you’re indulging in the delicate crunch of a house made waffle cone. With a decadent complexity and warmth, this fragrance will rouse memories of sweeter times with a deliciously crafted scent you’ll want to wear even more than you’ll want to eat.

menu.name: Sea Salt w/ Caramel Ribbons
menu.description: Our reimagination of the classic. We spike our cream with just enough Guatemalan fleur de sel to bring out its nuances, then drizzle in ribbons of our hand-burned caramel. Contains: Milk

menu.name: Double Fold Vanilla
menu.description: It’s called “double fold” for a reason: Our friends at Singing Dog use twice as many vanilla beans in their extract to pack an incredible punch. This definitely ain’t vanilla vanilla. Contains: Milk

menu.name: Chocolate Gooey Brownie
menu.description: For anyone who eats warm brownies right out of the pan. We fold fudgy chocolate-y brownie batter into intensely rich chocolate ice cream. Contains: Milk, Wheat, Eggs

menu.name: Cold Brew Coffee Cashew Praline
menu.description:
Homemade cashew praline amplifies the flavor of this bold, chocolate-y coffee ice cream. The caramelized praline brings out the beans’ juicy, citrusy qualities; the roasted nuts balance their floral notes.
Contains: Milk, Tree Nuts (cashews)

menu.name: Salted, Malted, Chocolate Chip Cookie dough
menu.description:
Made with the same bold malt you’d use to brew amber ale, our cookie dough is perfectly salty—we use two types of salt. Thick malted fudge rounds it all out.
Contains: Milk, Wheat

menu.name: Cinnamon Snickerdoodle
menu.description:
We fold our house-baked chewy snickerdoodle cookies into ice cream that’s spiked with the most intensely spiced, warm cinnamon.
Made with Red Ape Cinnamon
Contains: Milk, Wheat, Eggs

menu.name: Honey Lavender
menu.description:
Bliss for lavender lovers. We steep pounds of lavender petals in local honey, bringing out more complex, herbaceous flavors than you’ve ever experienced.
Contains: Milk

menu.name: Strawberry Honey Balsamic w/ Black Pepper
menu.description:
A strawberry triple threat. We steal a trick from the Italians, using balsamic and citrusy cubeb black pepper to help coax out the fruit's acidity and brightness.
Contains: Milk

menu.name: Pear & Blue Cheese
menu.description:
We candy Oregon bartletts to bring out their flavor, then fold in cave-aged crumbles of Rogue Creamery’s blue cheese (voted best in the world) for a bold thwack.
Contains: Milk

menu.name: Arbequina Olive Oil
menu.description:
Ice cream illuminates this incredible Oregon olive oil's velvety texture and tropical, grassy notes. At once simple and wildly complex.
Contains: Milk

menu.name: Freckled Mint Chocolate Chip (v)
menu.description:
Coconut and pure Oregon mint oil coalesce into a delicate, floral ice cream, freckled with organic dark chocolate.
Made with Seely Mint
Contains: Tree Nuts (coconut), Soy

menu.name: Marionberry Coconut Sherbet (v)
menu.description: While we’re lucky enough in Oregon to have these hulking berries hit our markets in summer, most of the world has never heard of them. Coconut cream and a little sugar are the only things we need to let the sweet-tart complexity of the marionberries shine in this creamy, refreshing flavor.Contains: Tree Nuts (coconut)

menu.name: Rhubarb Crumble w/ Toasted Anise
menu.description:
Along the West Coast, the humble, hardy rhubarb is a welcome sign of spring. We transform the PNW’s abundance of rhubarb into a simple crumble a la mode. To do so, we dark roast anise for the crumble, delivering a floral punch that can stand up to the acidity of rhubarb jam, the sum more satisfyingly complex than its individual parts. 
Contains: Milk, Wheat

menu.name: Mathilde's Hibiscus & Coconut Sherbet (v)
menu.description:
Hailing from the remote high mountains of Haiti, Mathilde spent her childhood learning her family’s traditional recipes over open flame. As an adult, she returned to start her own non-profit in her village to fund projects for a school and a health clinic. Now, after a successful run at food incubator Portland Mercado, Mathilde is on a mission to showcase the richness and beauty of Haiti through a different lens. She’s turned Haiti’s national flower, the hibiscus, into a spicy ginger brew. We simply add coconut cream and churn it into a bright, tropical sherbet.
Made with Mathilde’s Kitchen
Contains: Tree Nuts (coconut)

menu.name: House Made Waffle Cone
menu.description:
One house-made waffle cone to compliment your ice cream!
Contains: Wheat, Milk, Eggs, Soy

menu.name: Ice Cream Believer Socks
menu.description: When it pays off to have cold feet.” Pick up a pair of these vintage stripe socks and show the world that you’re an Ice Cream Believer!

menu.name: I Love You Washington Tote
menu.description: Worried your bag doesn’t say enough about the state you love? No fear, these Salt & Straw urban canvas totes, complete with vegan leather handles are here to help you upgrade and show your state pride at the same time! Like a craveable Sundae; the love for Washington all starts with a scoop of natural Northwest beauty, piled high with epic mountains, emerald forests, and our amazing communities as the cherry on top!

menu.name: I Love You Washington Tumbler
menu.description: Add an extra pep to your morning pick-me-up with our brand new Salt & Straw tumblers. An amazing way to show some pride and bring a little sweetness with you wherever you go. Like a craveable Sundae, the love for Washington all starts with a scoop of natural Northwest beauty, piled high with epic mountains, emerald forests, and our amazing communities as the cherry on top! These double insulated, stainless steel lined tumblers will keep your hots hot and your colds cold.

menu.name: Ampersand Beanie
menu.description: Brain freeze, meet your match. Stay cozy all winter with our super-soft knit beanie. One size fits all.

menu.name: Enamel Pin Set - 3 Pack
menu.description: Our enamel pin pack includes our bold Salt & Straw ampersand, a Salt & Straw striped ice cream cone, and a pin to prove you’re an Ice Cream Believer! Add them to your jacket, hat, or bag and express your sweetest side.

menu.name: Classic Buttery Jack® w/Swiss cheese
menu.description: Melted garlic herb butter on a 100% beef patty seasoned as it grills. Need we say more? Nay. But we will anyway. For real, this time.

menu.name: Bacon & Swiss Buttery Jack®
menu.description: Sometimes, a burger comes along that makes other burgers whimper in fear. This is that burger. Because this 100% beef patty seasoned as it grills is topped with melted herb butter, hickory smoked bacon, Swiss cheese, and creamy bacon mayo – and it’s all on our buttery signature bun. Don’t apologize, it’d be weirder if you weren’t drooling right now.

menu.name: Double Jack®
menu.description: This isn’t just a burger. This is a Declaration of Delicious. Two juicy, 100% beef patties seasoned as it grills with American Cheese, fresh sliced tomatoes, hand leafed lettuce, and real mayonnaise – all on a buttery bakery bun. Yeah, Great Britain wishes they could get their hands on this amazing piece of America.

menu.name: Bacon Ultimate Cheeseburger™
menu.description: How do you make an Ultimate Cheeseburger – with two 100% beef patties seasoned they grill, Hickory Smoked Bacon strips American and Swiss-style cheese, real mayonnaise, mustard, ketchup, all on a buttery bakery bun – even more ultimate? You add three slices of bacon. You read that correctly. Three. Whoever coined “three’s a crowd” has obviously never had this burger.

menu.name: Ultimate Cheeseburger™
menu.description: Can a cheeseburger change the world? Nah. Don’t be silly. But an Ultimate Cheeseburger? With two 100% beef patties seasoned as they grill, American and Swiss-style cheeses, real mayonnaise, mustard, and ketchup on a buttery bakery bun? That can change the world, alright. And maybe Mars. And perhaps that planet with the cool rings around it.

menu.name: Sourdough Jack®
menu.description: You claim you’re not hungry, but that’s before you read about a 100% beef patty seasoned as it’s grilled topped with hickory smoked bacon, tomato, Swiss-style cheese, real mayonnaise, and ketchup – All on a toasted sourdough bread. One more time for emphasis. Toasted. Sourdough. Bread. See? Now you’re hungry.

menu.name: Jumbo Jack®
menu.description: When you pick up the Jumbo Jack – made with a 100% beef patty seasoned as it grills topped with hand leafed lettuce, tomato, pickles, chopped onions, and real mayonnaise on a buttery bakery bun – your arms will tremble. And your mouth with open. It’s the delicious type of workout.

menu.name: Jr. Bacon Cheeseburger
menu.description: You ever call something “junior” ironically? Well, if you haven’t you’re about to. Because this Jr. Bacon Cheeseburger is a 100% beef patty seasoned as it grills topped with hickory smoked bacon, American cheese, real mayonnaise, and ketchup. And now you have a “junior” appetite. See what we did there?

menu.name: Jr. Jumbo Jack® Cheeseburger

But here? It's got some growing up to do.
